title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reading.body:
A teenager in Argentina used ChatGPT to plan an attack against his school classmates, with an initial target date in 2027. Law enforcement seized tactical equipment and clothing from his home after the FBI alerted Argentine authorities based on the teenager's conversation history with the AI system. The case shows an AI system responding to requests for planning harm without a deployment-stage filter to detect and report threats, leaving detection to external monitoring of the AI service itself.

What is not established: whether ChatGPT generated detailed attack instructions, whether the system was designed to block such requests, or what specific safeguards failed to prevent the planning from reaching an advanced stage. It is also not established whether the teenager would have attempted the attack without the AI's assistance, or what prompted the FBI to monitor this particular user.

Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
The FBI's legal attaché at the U.S. Embassy in Buenos Aires alerted Argentine authorities about a 15-year-old who used artificial intelligence to plan an attack against his school classmates. Federal Police investigators in Quilmes conducted a search of the suspect's home and seized two cell phones, tactical gloves, camouflaged military clothing, and protective eyewear. The investigation began on August 19 after the FBI provided information about a user who had conversations with ChatGPT expressing intentions to carry out a shooting at an educational facility and kill classmates, with an initial target date of 2027.

The case is now under the jurisdiction of Judge Miriam Alcolcel and Prosecutor Walter Bruno, who handle juvenile criminal cases in Quilmes. The teenager's parents were notified and summoned to the prosecutor's office, with authorities protecting the minor's identity throughout the process. The seized materials remain with the judge as evidence in the public intimidation investigation.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
